entities.name: agg_messages_weekly
entities.sql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('week', occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS week, count(*) FILTER (WHERE direction = 'in' AND NOT (b ~* '^(liked|loved|emphasized|laughed at|disliked|questioned) “' OR b ILIKE 'I accept receiving text messages%')) AS n_in, count(*) FILTER (WHERE direction IS DISTINCT FROM 'in' AND NOT (template_code IS NOT NULL OR (coalesce(is_automated, false) AND channel NOT IN ('sms', 'call')))) AS n_out, count(*) FILTER (WHERE direction IS DISTINCT FROM 'in' AND (template_code IS NOT NULL OR (coalesce(is_automated, false) AND channel NOT IN ('sms', 'call')))) AS n_auto FROM (SELECT *, btrim(regexp_replace(coalesce(body, ''), '\s*Chat in Linq:.*$', '')) AS b FROM messages) x WHERE (occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') >= date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') - interval '11 weeks' GROUP BY 1

entities.name: agg_messages_channels
entities.sql: SELECT coalesce(channel, '(не указано)') AS name, count(*) AS n FROM messages WHERE occurred_at >= now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY 1

entities.name: agg_messages_replies
entities.sql: WITH m AS ( SELECT order_id, occurred_at, CASE WHEN direction = 'in' AND (channel = 'call' OR (b ~* '^(liked|loved|emphasized|laughed at|disliked|questioned) “' OR b ILIKE 'I accept receiving text messages%') OR (length(b) <= 40 AND b ~* '^(thank|thx|ok\M|okay|great|perfect|sounds good|got it|awesome|cool|👍|🙏)')) THEN 'skip' WHEN direction = 'in' THEN 'in' WHEN (template_code IS NOT NULL OR (coalesce(is_automated, false) AND channel NOT IN ('sms', 'call'))) THEN 'auto' ELSE 'out' END AS kind FROM (SELECT *, btrim(regexp_replace(coalesce(body, ''), '\s*Chat in Linq:.*$', '')) AS b FROM messages) x WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL AND occurred_at >= now() - interval '120 days' ), mw AS ( SELECT order_id, occurred_at, kind, min(occurred_at) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'out') OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY occurred_at RANGE BETWEEN '1 microsecond'::interval FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS next_out FROM m ), manual AS ( SELECT order_id, occurred_at, kind, next_out, lag(kind) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY occurred_at) AS prev FROM mw WHERE kind IN ('in', 'out') ), turns AS ( SELECT order_id, occurred_at AS asked, next_out AS replied FROM manual WHERE kind = 'in' AND (prev IS NULL OR prev = 'out') ) SELECT 'all' AS scope, count(replied) AS replies, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM replied - asked) / 3600) FILTER (WHERE replied IS NOT NULL) AS median_hours, avg((replied - asked <= interval '1 hour')::int) FILTER (WHERE replied IS NOT NULL) AS within_1h, avg((replied - asked <= interval '24 hours')::int) FILTER (WHERE replied IS NOT NULL) AS within_24h FROM turns WHERE asked >= now() - interval '90 days'

entities.name: agg_messages_waiting
entities.sql: WITH m AS ( SELECT order_id, occurred_at, CASE WHEN direction = 'in' AND (channel = 'call' OR (b ~* '^(liked|loved|emphasized|laughed at|disliked|questioned) “' OR b ILIKE 'I accept receiving text messages%') OR (length(b) <= 40 AND b ~* '^(thank|thx|ok\M|okay|great|perfect|sounds good|got it|awesome|cool|👍|🙏)')) THEN 'skip' WHEN direction = 'in' THEN 'in' WHEN (template_code IS NOT NULL OR (coalesce(is_automated, false) AND channel NOT IN ('sms', 'call'))) THEN 'auto' ELSE 'out' END AS kind FROM (SELECT *, btrim(regexp_replace(coalesce(body, ''), '\s*Chat in Linq:.*$', '')) AS b FROM messages) x WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL AND occurred_at >= now() - interval '120 days' ), manual AS ( SELECT order_id, occurred_at, kind, lag(kind) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY occurred_at) AS prev FROM m WHERE kind IN ('in', 'out') ), turns AS ( SELECT t.order_id, t.occurred_at AS asked, (SELECT min(r.occurred_at) FROM m r WHERE r.order_id = t.order_id AND r.kind IN ('out', 'auto') AND r.occurred_at > t.occurred_at) AS replied FROM manual t WHERE t.kind = 'in' AND (t.prev IS NULL OR t.prev = 'out') ) SELECT o.order_no, o.stage, o.step, round(extract(epoch FROM now() - t.asked) / 3600) AS hours FROM turns t JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = t.order_id WHERE t.replied IS NULL AND t.asked <= now() - interval '2 hours' AND t.asked >= now() - interval '7 days' AND o.stage NOT LIKE 'Closed%' AND o.stage NOT IN ('Done', 'Delivered')

entities.name: agg_sla_weekly
entities.sql: WITH firsts AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (order_id) order_id, occurred_at AS started, direction, channel, coalesce(body, '') AS b FROM messages WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY order_id, occurred_at ), leads AS ( SELECT f.order_id, f.started, f.started AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AS loc FROM firsts f JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = f.order_id WHERE f.direction = 'in' AND f.channel IN ('sms', 'email', 'website') AND f.b !~ '^(Liked|Loved|Emphasized|Laughed at|Disliked|Questioned)' AND o.came_via IS DISTINCT FROM 'MP Form' AND o.came_via IS DISTINCT FROM 'Phone Call' AND coalesce(o.sources, '') NOT LIKE '%Facebook%' AND f.started >= now() - interval '130 days' ), due AS ( SELECT l.*, CASE WHEN extract(isodow FROM loc) <= 5 AND loc::time >= '09:00' AND loc::time < '18:00' THEN CASE WHEN date_trunc('day', loc) + interval '18 hours' - loc >= interval '4 hours' THEN loc + interval '4 hours' ELSE (loc::date + CASE extract(isodow FROM loc)::int WHEN 5 THEN 3 WHEN 6 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) + interval '9 hours' + (interval '4 hours' - (date_trunc('day', loc) + interval '18 hours' - loc)) END ELSE CASE WHEN extract(isodow FROM loc) <= 5 AND loc::time < '09:00' THEN loc::date + interval '9 hours' ELSE (loc::date + CASE extract(isodow FROM loc)::int WHEN 5 THEN 3 WHEN 6 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) + interval '9 hours' END + interval '1 hour' END AS deadline FROM leads l ), replies AS ( SELECT d.order_id, min(r.occurred_at) AS reply FROM due d JOIN messages r ON r.order_id = d.order_id AND r.occurred_at > d.started WHERE (r.direction = 'out' AND coalesce(r.template_code, 'composed') = 'composed' AND r.channel IN ('sms', 'email', 'call', 'yelp', 'thumbtack') AND coalesce(r.body, '') !~ '^(Liked|Loved|Emphasized|Laughed at|Disliked|Questioned)') OR (r.direction = 'in' AND r.channel = 'call' AND r.body ILIKE '%completed%' AND r.body ILIKE '%inbound%') GROUP BY d.order_id ), replied AS ( SELECT d.*, x.reply FROM due d LEFT JOIN replies x USING (order_id) ) SELECT to_char(date_trunc('week', loc), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS week, count(*) FILTER (WHERE deadline < now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') AS leads, count(*) FILTER (WHERE deadline < now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AND (reply IS NULL OR reply AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' > deadline)) AS late, count(*) FILTER (WHERE deadline >= now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') AS pending, count(*) FILTER (WHERE extract(isodow FROM loc) <= 5 AND loc::time >= '09:00' AND loc::time < '18:00' AND deadline < now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') AS leads_window, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM reply - started) / 60) FILTER (WHERE reply IS NOT NULL AND extract(isodow FROM loc) <= 5 AND loc::time >= '09:00' AND loc::time < '18:00') AS median_minutes_window FROM replied GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

entities.name: agg_photo_reminder_weekly
entities.sql: WITH m AS ( SELECT order_id, occurred_at, direction, channel, template_code, coalesce(body, '') AS b FROM messages WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL ), asks AS ( SELECT m.order_id, m.occurred_at FROM m JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = m.order_id WHERE m.direction = 'out' AND NOT (o.came_via IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'MP Form' AND coalesce(o.sources, '') LIKE '%Facebook%') AND (coalesce(m.template_code, '') ILIKE '%photo%' OR (coalesce(m.template_code, 'composed') = 'composed' AND m.b ~* '\m(photos?|pictures?|pics?|images?)\M')) ), media AS ( SELECT order_id, occurred_at FROM m WHERE direction = 'in' AND (b ~* '(linqapp\.com|public\.blob\.vercel-storage\.com|thumbtack\.com\S*\.jpe?g)' OR (channel = 'sms' AND b ~* '(^|\n)\s*\((photo|image|picture)s?\)\s*($|\n)')) ), firsts AS ( SELECT order_id, min(occurred_at) AS asked FROM asks GROUP BY order_id ), silent AS ( SELECT f.* FROM firsts f WHERE f.asked >= now() - interval '130 days' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media x WHERE x.order_id = f.order_id AND x.occurred_at <= f.asked + interval '1 day') ) SELECT to_char(date_trunc('week', asked AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS week, count(*) FILTER (WHERE asked <= now() - interval '3 days') AS silent, count(*) FILTER (WHERE asked <= now() - interval '3 days' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM asks a WHERE a.order_id = s.order_id AND a.occurred_at > s.asked AND a.occurred_at <= s.asked + interval '3 days' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media x WHERE x.order_id = s.order_id AND x.occurred_at <= a.occurred_at))) AS reminded, count(*) FILTER (WHERE asked > now() - interval '3 days') AS pending FROM silent s GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

entities.name: agg_quote_photo_weekly
entities.sql: WITH m AS ( SELECT order_id, occurred_at, direction, channel, template_code, coalesce(body, '') AS b FROM messages WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL ), photo AS ( SELECT order_id, min(occurred_at) AS photo_at FROM m WHERE direction = 'in' AND (b ~* '(linqapp\.com|public\.blob\.vercel-storage\.com|thumbtack\.com\S*\.jpe?g)' OR (channel = 'sms' AND b ~* '(^|\n)\s*\((photo|image|picture)s?\)\s*($|\n)')) GROUP BY order_id ), recent AS ( SELECT p.order_id, p.photo_at, p.photo_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AS loc FROM photo p WHERE p.photo_at >= now() - interval '130 days' ), due AS ( SELECT r.*, CASE WHEN extract(isodow FROM loc) <= 5 AND loc::time >= '09:00' AND loc::time < '18:00' THEN CASE WHEN date_trunc('day', loc) + interval '18 hours' - loc >= interval '4 hours' THEN loc + interval '4 hours' ELSE (loc::date + CASE extract(isodow FROM loc)::int WHEN 5 THEN 3 WHEN 6 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) + interval '9 hours' + (interval '4 hours' - (date_trunc('day', loc) + interval '18 hours' - loc)) END ELSE CASE WHEN extract(isodow FROM loc) <= 5 AND loc::time < '09:00' THEN loc::date + interval '9 hours' ELSE (loc::date + CASE extract(isodow FROM loc)::int WHEN 5 THEN 3 WHEN 6 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) + interval '9 hours' END + interval '4 hours' END AS deadline FROM recent r ), quoted AS ( SELECT d.*, least( (SELECT min(q.occurred_at) FROM m q WHERE q.order_id = d.order_id AND q.direction = 'out' AND q.occurred_at >= d.photo_at AND (q.b ~ '\$\s?[0-9]' OR coalesce(q.template_code, '') LIKE '%quote_sent')), (SELECT min(e.sent_at) FROM estimates e WHERE e.order_id = d.order_id AND e.sent_at >= d.photo_at)) AS quote_at FROM due d ) SELECT to_char(date_trunc('week', loc), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS week, count(*) FILTER (WHERE deadline < now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') AS photos, count(*) FILTER (WHERE deadline < now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AND (quote_at IS NULL OR quote_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' > deadline)) AS late, count(*) FILTER (WHERE deadline < now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AND quote_at IS NULL) AS no_quote, count(*) FILTER (WHERE deadline >= now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') AS pending FROM quoted GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

entities.name: agg_actions_weekly
entities.sql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('week', created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS week, author, count(*) AS actions FROM notes WHERE is_system AND author IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= now() - interval '130 days' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

entities.name: agg_site_weekly
entities.sql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('week', started_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS week, count(*) AS visits, count(order_id) AS orders FROM site_visits WHERE coalesce(test_tag, '') = '' AND (started_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') >= date_trunc('week', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago') - interval '11 weeks' GROUP BY 1

entities.name: agg_site_totals
entities.sql: SELECT 'all' AS scope, count(*) AS visits, count(order_id) AS orders FROM site_visits WHERE coalesce(test_tag, '') = '' AND started_at >= now() - interval '90 days'

entities.name: agg_site_sources
entities.sql: SELECT coalesce(nullif(source, ''), CASE WHEN referrer_host LIKE '%google.%' THEN 'Google, поиск' WHEN referrer_host LIKE '%facebook.com' OR referrer_host LIKE '%instagram.com' THEN 'Facebook и Instagram' WHEN referrer_host IS NULL OR referrer_host LIKE '%lerega.com' THEN 'Прямой заход' ELSE 'Другие сайты' END) AS name, count(*) AS visits, count(order_id) AS orders FROM site_visits WHERE coalesce(test_tag, '') = '' AND started_at >= now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY visits DESC LIMIT 10

entities.name: agg_site_devices
entities.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN lower(device) LIKE 'mobile%' THEN 'Телефон' WHEN lower(device) LIKE 'tablet%' THEN 'Планшет' WHEN lower(device) LIKE 'desktop%' THEN 'Компьютер' ELSE coalesce(nullif(device, ''), '(не указано)') END AS name, count(*) AS visits, count(order_id) AS orders FROM site_visits WHERE coalesce(test_tag, '') = '' AND started_at >= now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY visits DESC LIMIT 5

entities.name: agg_site_services
entities.sql: SELECT site_service AS name, count(*) AS visits, count(order_id) AS orders FROM site_visits WHERE coalesce(test_tag, '') = '' AND started_at >= now() - interval '90 days' AND site_service IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY visits DESC LIMIT 10

entities.name: agg_site_landings
entities.sql: SELECT coalesce(nullif(landing_path, ''), '(не указано)') AS name, count(*) AS visits, count(order_id) AS orders FROM site_visits WHERE coalesce(test_tag, '') = '' AND started_at >= now() - interval '90 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY visits DESC LIMIT 8

entities.name: agg_order_channel
entities.sql: WITH base AS ( SELECT o.order_id, o.order_no, o.sources, o.came_via, o.search_query, CASE WHEN (o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::time = '00:00' THEN (o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date ELSE (o.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago')::date END AS d FROM orders o ), b AS (SELECT * FROM base WHERE d >= DATE '2026-08-01'), tg AS ( SELECT b.order_id, array_agg(DISTINCT lower(trim(t))) FILTER (WHERE trim(t) <> '') AS tags FROM b LEFT JOIN LATERAL unnest(string_to_array(b.sources, ',')) AS t ON true GROUP BY b.order_id ), v AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (sv.order_id) sv.order_id, lower(coalesce(sv.utm_source,'')) AS vus, lower(coalesce(sv.utm_medium,'')) AS vum, lower(coalesce(sv.utm_campaign,'')) AS vuc, lower(coalesce(sv.source_tag,'')) AS vst, lower(coalesce(sv.site_source,'')) AS vss, lower(coalesce(sv.source,'')) AS vsrc, lower(coalesce(sv.landing_path,'')) AS vlp FROM site_visits sv JOIN b ON b.order_id = sv.order_id WHERE coalesce(trim(sv.test_tag),'') = '' ORDER BY sv.order_id, sv.started_at ), fm AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (m.order_id) m.order_id, CASE WHEN m.body ~* '^\s*(Form:\s*)?Leather Handbag Repair Phone' THEN 'hb' WHEN m.body ~* '^\s*(Form:\s*)?Leather Furniture Repair' THEN 'furn' WHEN m.body ~* '^\s*Facebook lead form\s*(1069516615662474|3741654905982561)' THEN 'hb_old' WHEN m.body ~* '^\s*Facebook lead form\s*1928981917796226' THEN 'furn_old' WHEN m.body ~* '^\s*Facebook lead form' AND m.body ~* 'Item\W{0,5}(Handbag|Purse|Bag)' THEN 'hb_old' WHEN m.body ~* '^\s*Facebook lead form' AND m.body ~* 'Item\W{0,5}(Furniture|Sofa|Couch|Chair|Sectional|Recliner|Ottoman)' THEN 'furn_old' WHEN m.body ~* '^\s*Facebook lead form' THEN 'unk_old' END AS form, substring(m.body from '^\s*Facebook lead form\s*([0-9]{6,})') AS lf_id FROM messages m JOIN b ON b.order_id = m.order_id WHERE m.direction = 'in' AND m.channel IN ('facebook','marketplace') ORDER BY m.order_id, m.occurred_at ), s0 AS ( SELECT b.order_id, b.order_no, b.came_via, coalesce(tg.tags, '{}'::text[]) AS tags, fm.form, fm.lf_id, (fm.order_id IS NOT NULL) AS fb_msg, replace(replace(replace(lower(coalesce(b.search_query,'')), '+', ' '), '%20', ' '), '%2b', ' ') AS sq, coalesce(v.vus,'') vus, coalesce(v.vum,'') vum, coalesce(v.vuc,'') vuc, coalesce(v.vst,'') vst, coalesce(v.vss,'') vss, coalesce(v.vsrc,'') vsrc, replace(replace(coalesce(v.vlp,''), '+', ' '), '%20', ' ') AS vlp FROM b LEFT JOIN tg USING (order_id) LEFT JOIN v USING (order_id) LEFT JOIN fm USING (order_id) ), s1 AS ( SELECT s0.*, coalesce(substring(sq from 'gad_campaignid=([0-9]+)'), substring(vlp from 'gad_campaignid=([0-9]+)')) AS gad_id, coalesce(substring(sq from '(?:utm_id|hsa_cam|utm_campaign)=(1202[0-9]{11,})'), substring(vlp from '(?:utm_id|hsa_cam|utm_campaign)=(1202[0-9]{11,})'), substring(vuc from '^(1202[0-9]{11,})$')) AS meta_id, trim(coalesce(substring(sq from 'utm_campaign=([^&#]+)'), substring(vlp from 'utm_campaign=([^&#]+)'), nullif(vuc,''))) AS ucamp, concat_ws('|', substring(sq from 'utm[_-]source=([^&#]+)'), substring(vlp from 'utm[_-]source=([^&#]+)'), nullif(vus,''), nullif(vst,''), nullif(vss,'')) AS usrc, concat_ws('|', substring(sq from 'utm[_-]medium=([^&#]+)'), substring(vlp from 'utm[_-]medium=([^&#]+)'), nullif(vum,'')) AS umed FROM s0 ), s2 AS ( SELECT s1.*, (sq ~ '(^|[?&])(gclid|gbraid|wbraid|gad_source)=' OR vlp ~ '(^|[?&])(gclid|gbraid|wbraid|gad_source)=' OR usrc ~ '(^|\|)gads' OR vsrc = 'google ads' OR (usrc ~ '(^|\|)google(\||$)' AND umed ~ '(^|\|)(cpc|ppc|paid)') OR 'google ads' = ANY(tags)) AS g_paid, (usrc ~ '(^|\|)fbads' OR sq ~ '(^|[?&])hsa_cam=' OR vsrc = 'facebook ads' OR (usrc ~ '(^|\|)(fb|facebook|ig|instagram|meta)(\||$)' AND umed ~ '(^|\|)(paid|cpc|ppc)') OR 'facebook ads' = ANY(tags)) AS m_paid, (usrc ~ '(^|\|)gptads' OR vsrc = 'gpt ads' OR (usrc ~ 'chatgpt' AND (umed ~ '(^|\|)(paid|cpc|ppc)' OR sq ~ 'cmpn' OR vlp ~ 'cmpn')) OR 'gpt ads' = ANY(tags)) AS gpt_paid, substring(usrc from '(?:gmap|applemap)_?(dt|lw|bc|rr|bk)') AS map_code FROM s1 ), c AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN meta_id = '120250326260370661' THEN 'Meta: форма сумок' WHEN meta_id = '120242432748130661' THEN 'Meta: форма мебели' WHEN meta_id = '120250385772880661' OR ucamp IN ('lerega.com - handbag - austin','lerega.com - handbag - us') THEN 'Meta: трафик сумки' WHEN meta_id = '120252184303420661' OR ucamp = 'fb-interests-course-rus' THEN 'Meta: обучение (rus)' WHEN meta_id = '120251997640840661' OR ucamp = 'fb-interests-course' THEN 'Meta: обучение (US)' WHEN gad_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Google Ads' WHEN meta_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Meta: кампания не определена' WHEN form IN ('hb','hb_old') THEN 'Meta: форма сумок' WHEN form IN ('furn','furn_old') THEN 'Meta: форма мебели' WHEN form = 'unk_old' THEN 'Meta: кампания не определена' WHEN g_paid THEN 'Google Ads' WHEN usrc ~ '(^|\|)fbads_hp' THEN 'Meta: трафик сумки' WHEN m_paid THEN 'Meta: кампания не определена' WHEN gpt_paid THEN 'ChatGPT Ads' WHEN 'thumbtack' = ANY(tags) THEN 'Thumbtack' WHEN 'angi' = ANY(tags) THEN 'Angi' WHEN 'yelp' = ANY(tags) THEN 'Yelp' WHEN map_code = 'dt' THEN 'Google Maps: Downtown' WHEN map_code = 'lw' THEN 'Google Maps: Lakeway' WHEN map_code = 'bc' THEN 'Google Maps: Bee Cave' WHEN map_code = 'rr' THEN 'Google Maps: Round Rock' WHEN map_code = 'bk' THEN 'Google Maps: BK' WHEN 'google map - downtown' = ANY(tags) THEN 'Google Maps: Downtown' WHEN 'google map - lakeway' = ANY(tags) OR 'apple map - lakeway' = ANY(tags) THEN 'Google Maps: Lakeway' WHEN 'google map - bee cave' = ANY(tags) THEN 'Google Maps: Bee Cave' WHEN 'google map - round rock' = ANY(tags) THEN 'Google Maps: Round Rock' WHEN 'google map - bk' = ANY(tags) THEN 'Google Maps: BK' WHEN 'google maps' = ANY(tags) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(tags) x WHERE x LIKE 'google map%' OR x LIKE 'apple map%') THEN 'Google Maps: профиль не указан' WHEN 'web search' = ANY(tags) THEN 'Поиск Google (органика)' WHEN 'facebook' = ANY(tags) OR fb_msg OR vsrc = 'facebook' OR usrc ~ '(^|\|)(fb|facebook)(\||$)' THEN 'Facebook (без рекламы)' WHEN 'instagram' = ANY(tags) OR vsrc = 'instagram' OR usrc ~ '(^|\|)(inst|ig|instagram)(\||$)' THEN 'Instagram' WHEN 'chatgpt' = ANY(tags) OR vsrc = 'chatgpt' OR usrc ~ 'chatgpt' THEN 'ChatGPT (органика)' WHEN tags && ARRAY['yellow pages','nextdoor','linkedin'] OR usrc ~ '(^|\|)(nextdoor|linkedin|yellowpages)' THEN 'Прочая органика' WHEN 'prior client' = ANY(tags) THEN 'Повторный клиент' WHEN 'shop visit' = ANY(tags) OR came_via = 'Shop Visit' THEN 'Пришёл в мастерскую' WHEN 'referral' = ANY(tags) THEN 'Рекомендация' ELSE 'Источник не указан' END AS channel, s2.* FROM s2 ) SELECT c.order_id, c.order_no, CASE WHEN c.channel = 'Google Ads' THEN 'Google Ads' WHEN c.channel LIKE 'Meta:%' THEN 'Meta Ads' WHEN c.channel = 'ChatGPT Ads' THEN 'ChatGPT Ads' WHEN c.channel IN ('Thumbtack','Angi','Yelp') THEN 'Лид-площадки' WHEN c.channel IN ('Повторный клиент','Пришёл в мастерскую','Рекомендация') THEN 'Повторные и рекомендации' WHEN c.channel = 'Источник не указан' THEN 'Не указан' ELSE 'Органика' END AS channel_group, c.channel, CASE WHEN c.channel = 'Google Ads' THEN CASE c.gad_id WHEN '24106203053' THEN 'furniture (основа)' WHEN '24106203050' THEN 'handbag (основа)' WHEN '24260970664' THEN 'handbag тест' WHEN '23446219354' THEN 'Maps-Austin (PMax)' WHEN '24178872612' THEN 'Maps-Austin (PMax)' WHEN '23879291461' THEN 'Maps-Austin (PMax)' WHEN '24354518552' THEN 'Training' ELSE CASE WHEN c.gad_id IS NULL THEN 'кампания не определена' ELSE 'кампания не определена (id ' || c.gad_id || ')' END END WHEN c.channel LIKE 'Meta:%' THEN coalesce(c.meta_id, nullif(c.ucamp, ''), CASE c.form WHEN 'hb' THEN 'лид-форма Leather Handbag Repair Phone' WHEN 'furn' THEN 'лид-форма Leather Furniture Repair' ELSE CASE WHEN c.form LIKE '%_old' THEN 'лид-форма Facebook lead form ' || coalesce(c.lf_id, '(id формы нет)') END END, CASE WHEN c.usrc ~ '(^|\|)fbads_hp' THEN 'FBAds_HP (id кампании не передан)' END, 'кампания не определена') WHEN c.channel = 'ChatGPT Ads' THEN substring(c.usrc from '(gptads[a-z0-9_]*)') ELSE NULL END AS campaign FROM c
